verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਚਨ ਹੋਵੇ ਪਾਰਸਹੁਂ ਕੰਚਨ ਕਰੈ ਨ ਕੰਚਨ ਹੋਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: ka(n)chan hove paarasahu(n) ka(n)chan karai na ka(n)chan horee|

en.bdb: Gold is made by the (touch of the) philosopher's stone but gold itself cannot produce gold.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਬਾਵਨ ਚੰਦਨਹੁਂ ਓਦੂੰ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਪਵੈ ਕਰੋਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan baavan cha(n)dhanahu(n) odhoo(n) hor na pavai karoree|

en.bdb: Sandal tree makes other tree fragrant but the latter cannot further make other trees fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵੁਠੈ ਜੰਮੈ ਬੀਜਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਫਲ ਭੋਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: vuThai ja(n)mai beejiaa satigur mat chitavai fal bhoree|

en.bdb: Sown seed sprouts only after it rains but adopting the teachings of the Guru, one attain fruit instantly.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਤਿ ਪਵੈ ਦਿਹੁ ਆਥਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਣ ਧੁਰ ਧੋਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: raat pavai dhih aathavai satigur gur pooran dhur dhoree|

en.bdb: The sun sets at the fall of night but the perfect Guru is there all the time.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੋਹਿਥ ਪਰਬਤ ਨਾ ਚੜ੍ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹਠ ਨਿਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਨ ਲਹੋਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: bohith parabat naa chaRhai satigur haTh nigrahu na lahoree|

en.bdb: As a ship cannot mount the mountain forcibly similarly, forced control over the senses is not liked by the true Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਧਰਤੀ ਨੋ ਭੁੰਚਾਲ ਡਰ ਗੁਰੁਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਚਲੈ ਨ ਚੋਰੀ।
verses.translit_en: dharatee no bhu(n)chaal ddar gurumat nihachal chalai na choree|

en.bdb: The earth may be scared of a quake and it becomes restive in its place but the Gurmat, Guru's tenets are steadfast and unconcealed.
The true Guru, in fact, is a bag full of jewels.
